premises.question: Do the September 20-25 programs expose repeated structural lessons that remain only partially transferred across CI, solver research, evidence infrastructure, and plan quality?
evidence: CI historical-value/cadence work separated proof value from per-PR cadence.
CI impact routing made semantic invalidation explicit while research result freshness remains coarser.
Hint consolidation and CI cache work repeatedly converged on one canonical producer/publication owner.

The research execution-efficiency audit already transferred exact runtime, sparse materialization, dependency reuse, and search-vs-plumbing separation, but not the broader cadence/freshness/proof-ownership lessons.
alternatives: Treat each program as domain-specific and close the retrospective with no cross-program backlog.
Create one giant generalized dependency/evidence framework immediately.
Record bounded cross-program pilots with concrete triggers and let repeated evidence earn generalization.
premises.discriminator: Use bounded concrete pilots (CP-1 through CP-8) and preserve live scientific priority; generalize only after repeated structure is demonstrated.

premises.question: Should remaining convergence work preempt current WS1/WS2 scientific gates?
evidence: The solver queue already has decision-ready or near-decision-ready WS1 and WS2 gates.
Several convergence items are infrastructure audits whose value depends on representative live consumers.
Past repo history shows infrastructure programs can expand if not tied to a live discriminator.
alternatives: Pause science and complete the infrastructure backlog first.
Ignore convergence work until all solver research closes.
Finish immediate WS1/WS2 gates, then run the highest-leverage convergence audits without creating a parallel scientific queue.
premises.discriminator: Keep solver-optimization-workstreams.md as priority authority and gate convergence work behind immediate scientific commitments.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Recurring research/evidence work has explicit claim ownership and justified cadence.

proofs.expected: Every in-scope recurring workflow names claim owner, invalidating inputs, current cadence, recommended cadence and retained proof/disposition.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Research semantic freshness is demonstrated on concrete expensive evidence families before any shared framework.

proofs.expected: Three evidence families have explicit invalidation contracts and at least one demonstrated coarse-freshness false positive or false negative.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Important invariants have one strongest canonical proof with weaker duplicates explicitly classified.

proofs.expected: Candidate invariants list canonical proof plus complementary/early-failure/migration/obsolete duplicate disposition; safe redundancies are removed or narrowed.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Derived resources publish from authoritative generation owners with exact generation identity.

proofs.expected: Each audited resource names source generation, producer, publication point, reuse identity, consumers and stale-generation failure mode; adjacent-consumer defects are repaired.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Permanent governance checks retain demonstrated current value or are moved/retired with retained forensic coverage.

proofs.expected: Each audited guard names bad state, current reachability, invalidating paths, overlap/unique catches and durable-vs-migration disposition.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Phase-local hostile sampling is either integrated into plan quality with bounded evidence or closed negative.

proofs.expected: Pilot measures signal/ceremony; plan-quality standard/template are updated only if earned, otherwise negative conclusion is retained.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Research cost/reuse facts are queryable without introducing a global ROI score.

proofs.expected: Joins question, acquisition/work cost, evidence and downstream reuse for at least two historical examples and records whether further persistent cost metadata is justified.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Additional CI structural work opens only from repeatable bounded-window timing evidence.

proofs.expected: New Vitest/materialization/compute work names a repeatable limiting mechanism; otherwise CP-8 stays closed/no-action.

definitionsOfDone.claim: Cross-program closeouts reconcile this backlog and each affected domain authority.

proofs.expected: Backlog and authority links remain valid after closeouts.

definitionsOfDone.claim: A fresh reconstruction can tell which CP items are implemented, closed negative, superseded, or explicitly deprioritized without trusting conversational history.

proofs.expected: Every CP-1..CP-8 item has an evidence-backed disposition and affected authority reconciliation.
proofs.reason: Cross-domain equivalence and absence of orphaned obligations require bounded independent reconstruction.
